svg.title: This separation justifies extending the real floor to a complex strip without a hidden dimension factor. Test the conjugated matrix against two fixed vectors and apply the one-variable Cauchy estimate to the resulting scalar analytic function. If its operator norm is bounded by M on a ball of radius R, its derivative is bounded by 2M/R on the half ball. Integrate along the segment from the real anchor to a nearby complex momentum. Choose that distance so that the perturbation norm is less than half the real lower bound in (MA2). The Neumann series then inverts the perturbed matrix with at most twice the anchored inverse bound. Apply this in the frozen frames, then restore the compared positive weights. All constants are fixed before L; none comes from summing matrix entries to estimate an operator norm.
